title: services: marketplace (send resources between own villages, exchange with NPC)
criteria:
Marketplace (T25 part a). Existing: `cfg.market` (MarketSection: merchant_speed 16 tiles/h at 1x, capacity_per_level 500, npc_fee 0.10), `Mission.TRADE`, building 'marketplace' (kind center), Movement.loot (JSONB dict resource -> amount). EDITING RULE: realm/services/military.py holds proofread Thai strings: change it ONLY with small targeted Edit operations (never rewrite the whole file); all new logic goes in the NEW file realm/services/market.py.
== realm/services/market.py ==
`market_info(s, village_id, cfg) -> dict` returns {'level': marketplace level (0 when none), 'capacity': level * cfg.market.capacity_per_level, 'fee': cfg.market.npc_fee, 'merchant_speed': cfg.market.merchant_speed}.
`send_resources(s, player_id, from_village_id, to_village_id, resources: dict[str, float], now, cfg) -> Movement`: villages.lock_village for both villages in ASCENDING id order; owner check on the sender (GameError FORBIDDEN, villages.FORBIDDEN_TH); the destination must exist (NOT_FOUND villages.VILLAGE_NOT_FOUND_TH), belong to the SAME player and differ from the sender (else INVALID_TARGET 'ปลายทางไม่ถูกต้อง'); villages.settle_village for the sender; sender marketplace level < 1 -> REQUIREMENTS_NOT_MET f'ต้องมี {cfg.buildings["marketplace"].name_th} เลเวล 1'; amounts: keys must be among wood/stone/iron/food (else INVALID_TARGET 'ชนิดทรัพยากรไม่ถูกต้อง'), values >= 0, floor each to an integer, total must be > 0 (else INVALID_UNITS 'จำนวนไม่ถูกต้อง') and <= capacity (else INVALID_UNITS 'ปริมาณเกินความจุของตลาด'); the sender stock must cover it (INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES villages.INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES_TH); deduct; create Movement(world_id, player_id, from_village_id=sender, to_x/to_y = destination coordinates, to_village_id=destination, mission 'trade', units {}, loot = the integer amounts as floats, catapult_target None, departed_at=now, arrive_at = now + timedelta(seconds=max(1.0, distance / cfg.market.merchant_speed * 3600 / world.speed)) with distance from realm.core.movement.distance, status 'moving'); flush; events.schedule(MOVEMENT_ARRIVE at arrive_at, {'movement_id': id}); villages.after_change(sender); notify the owner (kind 'village', sender id); return the Movement.
`resolve_trade_arrival(s, m, now, cfg) -> None`: lock the destination village, settle it, add m.loot to its stock and clamp to [0, capacity] using villages.compute_rates for the capacity (overflow is lost), set m.status 'done', villages.after_change, a report kind 'info' to the owner titled 'ส่งทรัพยากรถึงแล้ว' with data {'from_village_id', 'to_village_id', 'loot': m.loot, 'delivered': the amounts actually added per resource}, notify.
`exchange(s, player_id, village_id, give: str, take: str, amount: float, now, cfg) -> dict`: lock village, owner check, settle; marketplace level < 1 -> REQUIREMENTS_NOT_MET (same message as above); give/take must be different resources among the four else INVALID_TARGET 'ชนิดทรัพยากรไม่ถูกต้อง'; amount = floor(amount) must be >= 1 else INVALID_UNITS 'จำนวนไม่ถูกต้อง'; stock[give] >= amount else INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES; gained = floor(amount * (1 - cfg.market.npc_fee) + 1e-9); stock[give] -= amount; stock[take] = min(capacity[take], stock[take] + gained); flush; villages.after_change; notify; return {'gave': amount, 'received': the amount actually added after capping, 'fee': amount - gained}.
== realm/services/military.py (small Edits) ==
(1) In `resolve_arrival` add the branch: elif m.mission == Mission.TRADE.value: market.resolve_trade_arrival(s, m, now, cfg) (import `market` from realm.services; keep the import cycle-free: market.py must not import military at module level). (2) `_check_send` must reject sending the mission TRADE through send_troops exactly like RETURN is rejected (same problem tuple with the existing RETURN_MISSION_TH message), by extending the existing `if mission is Mission.RETURN` condition to `in (Mission.RETURN, Mission.TRADE)`.

Hand-computed: market_info(A) == {'level': 2, 'capacity': 1000.0, 'fee': 0.1, 'merchant_speed': 16.0}; send 300 wood + 200 iron A -> B at t0: stock A 450/750/550/750 (750-300, 750, 750-200, 750), Movement mission 'trade', loot {'wood': 300.0, 'iron': 200.0}, to_village_id B, arrive_at = t0 + 7/16*3600 = t0 + 1575 s (7 tiles at 16/h), one MOVEMENT_ARRIVE event; at arrival (resolve_arrival at 1575 s) B stock wood 300, iron 200, stone 0, food 0 (B has res_updated_at t0 so settling adds its own production for 1575 s: set B's production to zero by giving B level-0 fields... simpler: assert B.wood >= 300 and B.iron >= 200 within the production of 1575 s using compute_rates: B wood = 300 + rates.wood * 1575/3600 within 1e-6), movement 'done', an 'info' report titled 'ส่งทรัพยากรถึงแล้ว'; capacity overflow: B stock 700 wood (capacity 800), sending 300 wood -> B wood == 800 and report delivered wood == 100; errors: no marketplace -> REQUIREMENTS_NOT_MET; total 1001 (> capacity 1000) -> INVALID_UNITS; total 0 or negative amount -> INVALID_UNITS; unknown resource key -> INVALID_TARGET; stock short (wood 800 when stock 750) -> INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES and nothing changes; destination = same village or the bot's village (other player) -> INVALID_TARGET; unknown destination -> NOT_FOUND; other player's id -> FORBIDDEN; sending mission TRADE through military.send_troops raises INVALID_TARGET with the RETURN message; speed 10 world: arrival time is 157.5 s; exchange: give 100 wood take iron at stock 750: wood 650, iron 750 + 90 = 840 and the result {'gave': 100, 'received': 90, 'fee': 10}; capped by capacity (iron stock 790 with capacity 800: received 10); 150 gives floor(150*0.9) = 135; same resource -> INVALID_TARGET; amount 0.5 -> INVALID_UNITS; stock short -> INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES; no marketplace -> REQUIREMENTS_NOT_MET; engine path: send then realm.engine.worker.process_next(s, world, arrive_at, cfg) delivers.
notes:
- Thai strings: use ONLY these exact strings (copy letter by letter; proofread): 'ปลายทางไม่ถูกต้อง', 'ชนิดทรัพยากรไม่ถูกต้อง', 'จำนวนไม่ถูกต้อง', 'ปริมาณเกินความจุของตลาด', 'ส่งทรัพยากรถึงแล้ว', the f-string 'ต้องมี {name_th} เลเวล 1'. Reuse villages.FORBIDDEN_TH, villages.VILLAGE_NOT_FOUND_TH, villages.INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES_TH. Do not retype any other Thai in existing files.
- Real columns only in tests.
- Never commit; never call datetime.now(). Lock order ascending village id.
- Existing tests must keep passing.
